title: Develop reveal
summary: Images appear overexposed and settle to normal, like a photo developing, staggered across a grid.
use_when: Galleries of generated or photographic output.
avoid_when: UI cards or text; the flash only works on imagery.
recipe:
@keyframes develop { from { filter: brightness(1000%) sepia(20%); } to { filter: brightness(100%) sepia(0%); } }
.tile.in { animation: develop 750ms cubic-bezier(0, 0.55, 0.45, 1) both; }  /* add .in as each tile enters the viewport */
